`gopher.webp` is the unchanged `gopher-doc.1bpp.lossless.webp` from
`golang.org/x/image v0.45.0/testdata`; its BSD license is included in LICENSE.
PNG/JPEG are deterministic 2×2 red/blue test images encoded by Go's standard
library in `classifierAssets`. All three original binary assets, MIME types,
decoded/base64/data-URL lengths and SHA-256 are saved in E2E evidence.
